title: 2 RED ACRYLIC BAR STOOLS
reason: Form matches the Kartell Charles Ghost bar stool by Philippe Starck; a genuine pair is worth real money, copies are common, so check the underside for a moulded Kartell mark.
findings: Two tall bar stools in one-piece moulded translucent orange-red plastic: round seat with a small central hole, flared curved legs, a round footrest ring and small moulded tabs on the seat skirt. The form matches the Kartell 'Charles Ghost' stool designed by Philippe Starck (a widely copied design). No Kartell logo, Starck name or other moulded mark is visible; the underside of the seats and the legs are not shown, so genuine versus copy cannot be told from the photo. Paper tags tied to the legs are illegible. The title says acrylic; the genuine Kartell stool is polycarbonate.
condition: Both stools look clean and glossy with no cracks or crazing visible in the single photo; feet and underside not shown so scuffing is unknown.
rescore_note: Form matches the Kartell Charles Ghost bar stool, but no Kartell mark is visible, the title says acrylic and replicas are far more common, so most likely a replica pair of low value with perhaps a 1 in 5 chance of a genuine pair worth over $200; blended into the lower $80-200 band; leg ends look scuffed in an enlarged crop (judgement, no live comps this run).
